columns.name: activity_year
columns.description: The reporting or activity year; all rows in this table have the four-digit year 2018.

columns.name: lei
columns.description: A lender identifier, represented by string values such as 549300HW662MN1WU8550. The profile does not provide a more specific interpretation of the identifier.

columns.name: derived_msa_md
columns.description: A numeric code for the derived metropolitan statistical area or metropolitan division. Values range from 0 to 99999, with 99999 the most frequent; the profile does not specify the meaning of individual codes.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: The two-letter code for the state associated with the property. A small share of values are missing.

columns.name: county_code
columns.description: A numeric county identifier associated with the property; values range from 1001 to 80550. Some values are missing, and the profile does not provide a code-to-county mapping.

columns.name: census_tract
columns.description: A numeric Census tract identifier associated with the property, represented as a decimal-valued number. Some values are missing; the profile does not provide a tract-label mapping.

columns.name: conforming_loan_limit
columns.description: A categorical code describing the loan’s conforming-loan-limit status, with observed values C, NC, and U. The profile does not define the individual codes. Official definition: Indicates whether the reported loan amount exceeds the GSE (government sponsored enterprise) conforming loan limit. Codes: C = Conforming; NC = Nonconforming; U = Undetermined; NA = Not Applicable.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Indicates whether the reported loan amount exceeds the GSE (government sponsored enterprise) conforming loan limit. Codes: C = Conforming; NC = Nonconforming; U = Undetermined; NA = Not Applicable.

columns.name: derived_loan_product_type
columns.description: The derived loan product category, combining loan program and lien position, as shown by labels such as Conventional:First Lien and FHA:Subordinate Lien.

columns.name: derived_dwelling_category
columns.description: The derived property dwelling category, distinguishing single-family (1–4 unit) from multifamily and site-built from manufactured housing.

columns.name: derived_ethnicity
columns.description: The derived applicant ethnicity category, with values including Hispanic or Latino, Not Hispanic or Latino, Joint, and categories indicating unavailable or free-form-only information.

columns.name: derived_race
columns.description: The derived applicant race category, with values including White, Asian, and Black or African American, as well as Joint, 2 or more minority races, and Race Not Available.
domain_values: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

columns.name: derived_sex
columns.description: The derived applicant sex category, with values Male, Female, Joint, and Sex Not Available.

columns.name: action_taken
columns.description: A coded application or loan outcome; codes map to labels in action_taken_name. For example, 1 means Loan originated, 3 means Application denied by financial institution, and 6 means Loan purchased by the institution. Official definition: The action taken on the covered loan or application. Codes: 1 = Loan originated; 2 = Application approved but not accepted; 3 = Application denied; 4 = Application withdrawn by applicant; 5 = File closed for incompleteness; 6 = Purchased loan; 7 = Preapproval request denied; 8 = Preapproval request approved but not accepted.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The action taken on the covered loan or application. Codes: 1 = Loan originated; 2 = Application approved but not accepted; 3 = Application denied; 4 = Application withdrawn by applicant; 5 = File closed for incompleteness; 6 = Purchased loan; 7 = Preapproval request denied; 8 = Preapproval request approved but not accepted.

columns.name: purchaser_type
columns.description: A code for the type of purchaser, with corresponding labels in purchaser_type_name for codes including 0 (not originated or not sold in the calendar year), 1 (Fannie Mae), and 2 (Ginnie Mae). Codes 71 and 72 also occur, but their labels are not supplied in the profile.

columns.name: preapproval
columns.description: A code indicating whether preapproval was requested: 1 means Preapproval requested and 2 means Preapproval not requested, with labels in preapproval_name.

columns.name: loan_type
columns.description: A coded loan program, with labels in loan_type_name: 1 Conventional, 2 FHA-insured, 3 VA-guaranteed, and 4 FSA/RHS-guaranteed. Official definition: The type of covered loan or application. Codes: 1 = Conventional (not insured or guaranteed by FHA, VA, RHS, or FSA); 2 = Federal Housing Administration insured (FHA); 3 = Veterans Affairs guaranteed (VA); 4 = USDA Rural Housing Service or Farm Service Agency guaranteed (RHS or FSA).
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The type of covered loan or application. Codes: 1 = Conventional (not insured or guaranteed by FHA, VA, RHS, or FSA); 2 = Federal Housing Administration insured (FHA); 3 = Veterans Affairs guaranteed (VA); 4 = USDA Rural Housing Service or Farm Service Agency guaranteed (RHS or FSA).

columns.name: loan_purpose
columns.description: A coded loan purpose, with labels in loan_purpose_name for code 1 (Home purchase) and code 2 (Home improvement). Codes 4, 5, 31, and 32 also occur, but their labels are not supplied in the profile. Official definition: The purpose of covered loan or application. Codes: 1 = Home purchase; 2 = Home improvement; 31 = Refinancing; 32 = Cash-out refinancing; 4 = Other purpose; 5 = Not applicable.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The purpose of covered loan or application. Codes: 1 = Home purchase; 2 = Home improvement; 31 = Refinancing; 32 = Cash-out refinancing; 4 = Other purpose; 5 = Not applicable.

columns.name: lien_status
columns.description: A lien-position code: 1 means Secured by a first lien and 2 means Secured by a subordinate lien, with labels in lien_status_name. Official definition: Lien status of the property securing the covered loan, or in the case of an application, proposed to secure the covered loan. Codes: 1 = Secured by a first lien; 2 = Secured by a subordinate lien.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Lien status of the property securing the covered loan, or in the case of an application, proposed to secure the covered loan. Codes: 1 = Secured by a first lien; 2 = Secured by a subordinate lien.

columns.name: reverse_mortgage
columns.description: A reverse-mortgage code, with labels in reverse_mortgage_name: 2 means Not a reverse mortgage and 1111 means Exempt. Official definition: Whether the covered loan or application is for a reverse mortgage. Codes: 1 = Reverse mortgage; 2 = Not a reverse mortgage; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the covered loan or application is for a reverse mortgage. Codes: 1 = Reverse mortgage; 2 = Not a reverse mortgage; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: open_end_line_of_credit
columns.description: A coded indicator for whether the loan is an open-end line of credit, with observed values 1, 2, and 1111. The profile does not provide labels or meanings for these codes. Official definition: Whether the covered loan or application is for an open-end line of credit. Codes: 1 = Open-end line of credit; 2 = Not an open-end line of credit; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the covered loan or application is for an open-end line of credit. Codes: 1 = Open-end line of credit; 2 = Not an open-end line of credit; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: business_or_commercial_purpose
columns.description: A coded indicator associated with business or commercial purpose, with observed values 1, 2, and 1111. The profile does not provide labels or meanings for these codes. Official definition: Whether the covered loan or application is primarily for a business or commercial purpose. Codes: 1 = Primarily for a business or commercial purpose; 2 = Not primarily for a business or commercial purpose; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the covered loan or application is primarily for a business or commercial purpose. Codes: 1 = Primarily for a business or commercial purpose; 2 = Not primarily for a business or commercial purpose; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: loan_amount
columns.description: The numeric loan amount, with observed values from 5000 to 350005000 and no nulls. The profile does not specify a currency or reporting unit. Official definition: The amount of the covered loan, or the amount applied for.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The amount of the covered loan, or the amount applied for.

columns.name: loan_to_value_ratio
columns.description: A numeric loan-to-value ratio, with common values such as 80, 95, and 96.5, consistent with percentage values. About 20.8% of entries are missing; observed values range from 0.01 to 99900.

columns.name: interest_rate
columns.description: A numeric interest-rate value, with common observations such as 4.75 and 5.25, consistent with rates expressed as percentages. About 26.7% of entries are missing; observed values range from 0.001 to 4250. Official definition: The interest rate for the covered loan or application.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The interest rate for the covered loan or application.

columns.name: rate_spread
columns.description: A numeric rate-spread value, with common observations including 0, 0.16, and 1, consistent with a spread expressed in percentage points. About 37.9% of entries are missing; observed values range from -10 to 99.99. Official definition: The difference between the covered loan's annual percentage rate (APR) and the average prime offer rate (APOR) for a comparable transaction as of the date the interest rate is set.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The difference between the covered loan's annual percentage rate (APR) and the average prime offer rate (APOR) for a comparable transaction as of the date the interest rate is set.

columns.name: hoepa_status
columns.description: Categorical indicator of whether a loan has HOEPA status. Code 1 is labeled “HOEPA loan” and code 2 “Not a HOEPA loan”; code 3 also occurs, but its label is not provided. Official definition: Whether the covered loan is a high-cost mortgage. Codes: 1 = High-cost mortgage; 2 = Not a high-cost mortgage; 3 = Not applicable.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the covered loan is a high-cost mortgage. Codes: 1 = High-cost mortgage; 2 = Not a high-cost mortgage; 3 = Not applicable.

columns.name: total_loan_costs
columns.description: Total loan costs, recorded as a numeric monetary amount (apparently dollars). Values range from 0 to 125,505.03; the field is null for about 36% of records. Official definition: The amount, in dollars, of total loan costs.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The amount, in dollars, of total loan costs.

columns.name: total_points_and_fees
columns.description: Total points and fees, recorded as a numeric monetary amount (apparently dollars). It is null for nearly all records (about 99.98%), and the observed non-null values range from 0 to 23,669.50. Official definition: The total points and fees, in dollars, charged in connection with the covered loan.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The total points and fees, in dollars, charged in connection with the covered loan.

columns.name: origination_charges
columns.description: Charges associated with originating the loan, recorded as a numeric monetary amount (apparently dollars). Observed values range from 0 to 66,467, and about 39% of records are null. Official definition: The total of all itemized amounts, in dollars, that are designated borrower-paid at or before closing.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The total of all itemized amounts, in dollars, that are designated borrower-paid at or before closing.

columns.name: discount_points
columns.description: Discount points charged for the loan, represented by numeric amounts (apparently dollars). Values range from 0.10 to 37,499.98; about 89.5% of records are null. Official definition: The points paid, in dollars, to the creditor to reduce the interest rate.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The points paid, in dollars, to the creditor to reduce the interest rate.

columns.name: lender_credits
columns.description: Credits provided by the lender, represented by numeric amounts (apparently dollars). Observed values range from 0.01 to 27,120; about 89% of records are null. Official definition: The amount, in dollars, of lender credits.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The amount, in dollars, of lender credits.

columns.name: loan_term
columns.description: The loan term, most likely measured in months, with common values such as 360, 180, and 300. Observed values range from 1 to 600, and about 2.8% of records are null. Official definition: The number of months after which the legal obligation will mature or terminate, or would have matured or terminated.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The number of months after which the legal obligation will mature or terminate, or would have matured or terminated.

columns.name: prepayment_penalty_term
columns.description: The term associated with a prepayment penalty, most likely measured in months; observed values are 0, 6, 12, 24, and 36. About 98.6% of records are null, and the profile does not provide a label for the meaning of 0. Official definition: The term, in months, of any prepayment penalty.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The term, in months, of any prepayment penalty.

columns.name: intro_rate_period
columns.description: The introductory-rate period, most likely measured in months, with common values including 1, 60, 84, and 120. Values range from 1 to 600; about 88.5% of records are null. Official definition: The number of months until the first date the interest rate may change after closing or account opening (proposed number for applications).
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The number of months until the first date the interest rate may change after closing or account opening (proposed number for applications).

columns.name: negative_amortization
columns.description: A categorical indicator concerning negative amortization, encoded with values 1, 2, and 1111. The profile does not provide labels for codes 1 and 2; 1111 is a special code rather than a measured amount. Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, a term that would cause the covered loan to be a negative amortization loan. Codes: 1 = Negative amortization; 2 = No negative amortization; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, a term that would cause the covered loan to be a negative amortization loan. Codes: 1 = Negative amortization; 2 = No negative amortization; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: interest_only_payment
columns.description: A categorical indicator for whether the loan has an interest-only payment feature, encoded with values 1, 2, and 1111. The profile does not provide labels for codes 1 and 2; 1111 is a special code rather than a measured amount. Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, interest-only payments. Codes: 1 = Interest-only payments; 2 = No interest-only payments; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, interest-only payments. Codes: 1 = Interest-only payments; 2 = No interest-only payments; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: balloon_payment
columns.description: A categorical indicator for a balloon-payment feature, encoded with values 1, 2, and 1111. The profile does not provide labels for codes 1 and 2; 1111 is a special code rather than a measured amount. Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, a balloon payment. Codes: 1 = Balloon payment; 2 = No balloon payment; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, a balloon payment. Codes: 1 = Balloon payment; 2 = No balloon payment; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: other_nonamortizing_features
columns.description: A categorical indicator for other non-amortizing loan features, encoded with values 1, 2, and 1111. The profile does not provide labels for codes 1 and 2; 1111 is a special code rather than a measured amount. Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, any term, other than negative amortization, interest-only payments, or balloon payments, that would allow for payments other than fully amortizing payments. Codes: 1 = Other non-fully amortizing features; 2 = No other non-fully amortizing features; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, any term, other than negative amortization, interest-only payments, or balloon payments, that would allow for payments other than fully amortizing payments. Codes: 1 = Other non-fully amortizing features; 2 = No other non-fully amortizing features; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: property_value
columns.description: The value reported for the property securing the loan, represented as a numeric monetary amount (apparently dollars). Observed values range from 5,000 to 1,286,685,000, and about 16.1% of records are null. Official definition: The value of the property securing the covered loan or, in the case of an application, proposed to secure the covered loan, relied on in making the credit decision.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The value of the property securing the covered loan or, in the case of an application, proposed to secure the covered loan, relied on in making the credit decision.

columns.name: construction_method
columns.description: A coded category describing the construction method of the property, with codes 1 and 2. The profile does not provide labels that identify what either code means. Official definition: Construction method for the dwelling. Codes: 1 = Site-built; 2 = Manufactured home.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Construction method for the dwelling. Codes: 1 = Site-built; 2 = Manufactured home.

columns.name: occupancy_type
columns.description: The property's occupancy category: code 1 is “Principal residence,” code 2 is “Second residence,” and code 3 is “Investment property.” Official definition: Occupancy type for the dwelling. Codes: 1 = Principal residence; 2 = Second residence; 3 = Investment property.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Occupancy type for the dwelling. Codes: 1 = Principal residence; 2 = Second residence; 3 = Investment property.

columns.name: manufactured_home_secured_property_type
columns.description: A coded category describing the property type for a loan secured by a manufactured home; observed codes are 1, 2, 3, and 1111. The profile does not provide labels for codes 1–3, and 1111 is a special code rather than a property-type measurement. Official definition: Whether the covered loan is, or would have been, secured by a manufactured home and land, or by a manufactured home and not land. Codes: 1 = Manufactured home and land; 2 = Manufactured home and not land; 3 = Not applicable; 1111 = Exempt.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: Whether the covered loan is, or would have been, secured by a manufactured home and land, or by a manufactured home and not land. Codes: 1 = Manufactured home and land; 2 = Manufactured home and not land; 3 = Not applicable; 1111 = Exempt.

columns.name: manufactured_home_land_property_interest
columns.description: A coded category describing the land-property interest associated with a manufactured home; observed codes are 1–5 and 1111. The profile does not provide labels for codes 1–5, and 1111 is a special code rather than a land-interest measurement.

columns.name: total_units
columns.description: The number of units in the property, with observed integer values from 1 to 4. About 0.5% of records are null.

columns.name: multifamily_affordable_units
columns.description: A measure associated with affordable units in a multifamily property, represented on a 0–100 scale and likely as a percentage. It is null for about 99.8% of records; the profile alone does not establish whether values are percentages or counts.

columns.name: income
columns.description: The applicant's reported income, represented numerically; the profile does not specify a unit. Values range from -17,004 to 937,000, with about 5.2% of records null.

columns.name: debt_to_income_ratio
columns.description: The applicant's debt-to-income ratio, represented by a mixture of percentage bands and numeric percentage values (including 36–49). Categories include “<20%,” “20%-<30%,” “30%-<36%,” “50%-60%,” and “>60%”; “Exempt” is also an observed value. Official definition: The ratio, as a percentage, of the applicant's or borrower's total monthly debt to the total monthly income relied on in making the credit decision.
columns.glossary_text: Official definition: The ratio, as a percentage, of the applicant's or borrower's total monthly debt to the total monthly income relied on in making the credit decision.

columns.name: applicant_credit_score_type
columns.description: A coded category identifying the type of credit score information for the applicant, with codes 1–9 and 1111. These are score-type codes, not the applicant's numeric credit score; the profile does not provide labels for the codes.

columns.name: co_applicant_credit_score_type
columns.description: A coded category identifying the type of credit score information for the co-applicant, with codes 1–10 and 1111. These are score-type codes, not the co-applicant's numeric credit score; the profile does not provide labels for the codes.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_1
columns.description: The applicant's first ethnicity category, encoded by codes 1, 2, 3, 4, and 11–14. The paired labels identify Hispanic or Latino (1), Not Hispanic or Latino (2), information not provided (3), Not applicable (4), Mexican (11), Puerto Rican (12), Cuban (13), and Other Hispanic or Latino (14).

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_2
columns.description: A second coded ethnicity selection for the applicant, using the same categories as applicant_ethnicity_2_name (for example, 11 = Mexican and 12 = Puerto Rican). It is missing for about 96% of rows; nonmissing values include Hispanic/Latino categories and code 2, Not Hispanic or Latino.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_3
columns.description: A third coded ethnicity selection for the applicant, with categories including 11 = Mexican, 12 = Puerto Rican, 13 = Cuban, 14 = Other Hispanic or Latino, and 2 = Not Hispanic or Latino. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_4
columns.description: A fourth coded ethnicity-selection field for the applicant. It is effectively entirely missing; the profile shows code 13 (Cuban) among its values but does not provide a label-column mapping for this field.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_5
columns.description: A fifth coded ethnicity-selection field for the applicant. It is entirely missing in the profiled data, so no category values or labels are available.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_1
columns.description: The co-applicant’s primary coded ethnicity response. Labels include 1 = Hispanic or Latino, 2 = Not Hispanic or Latino, 3 = information not provided, 4 = not applicable, and 5 = no co-applicant; codes 11–14 specify Hispanic/Latino groups such as Mexican, Puerto Rican, Cuban, and Other Hispanic or Latino.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_2
columns.description: A second coded ethnicity selection for the co-applicant, with codes for Hispanic/Latino groups and code 2 for Not Hispanic or Latino. It is missing for about 99% of rows; no paired label column is specified in the profile.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_3
columns.description: A third coded ethnicity selection for the co-applicant, with observed codes 11, 13, and 14 corresponding to Mexican, Cuban, and Other Hispanic or Latino in the related ethnicity coding. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_4
columns.description: A fourth coded ethnicity-selection field for the co-applicant. It is entirely missing in the profiled data, with no category values available.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_5
columns.description: A fifth coded ethnicity-selection field for the co-applicant. It is entirely missing in the profiled data, with no category values available.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_observed
columns.description: A coded field associated with whether or how the applicant’s ethnicity was observed; it contains integer codes 1–3. The profile does not supply the meanings of those codes.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_observed
columns.description: A coded field associated with whether or how the co-applicant’s ethnicity was observed; it contains integer codes 1–4. The profile does not supply the meanings of those codes.

columns.name: applicant_race_1
columns.description: The applicant’s primary coded race selection. Labels include 1 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 2 = Asian, 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and 5 = White; code 6 means information was not provided and code 7 is not applicable. Codes 21–27 and 41–44 identify specific Asian and Pacific Islander groups.

columns.name: applicant_race_2
columns.description: A second coded race selection for the applicant, using the race categories labeled in applicant_race_2_name (including specific Asian and Pacific Islander groups). It is missing for about 96% of rows.

columns.name: applicant_race_3
columns.description: A third coded race selection for the applicant, using codes for race categories and specific Asian and Pacific Islander groups. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: applicant_race_4
columns.description: A fourth coded race selection for the applicant, with values representing race categories and specific Asian and Pacific Islander groups. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: applicant_race_5
columns.description: A fifth coded race selection for the applicant, with values representing race categories and specific Asian and Pacific Islander groups. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_1
columns.description: The co-applicant’s primary coded race selection. Labels include 1 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 2 = Asian, 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and 5 = White; code 6 means information was not provided, 7 is not applicable, and 8 means no co-applicant. Other codes identify specific Asian or Pacific Islander groups.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_2
columns.description: A second coded race selection for the co-applicant, with values covering race categories and specific Asian or Pacific Islander groups. It is missing for more than 99% of rows; no paired label column is specified in the profile.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_3
columns.description: A third coded race selection for the co-applicant, with values covering race categories and specific Asian or Pacific Islander groups. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_4
columns.description: A fourth coded race selection for the co-applicant, with values covering race categories and specific Asian or Pacific Islander groups. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_5
columns.description: A fifth coded race selection for the co-applicant, with observed codes 3, 5, and 43; the race coding identifies these as Black or African American, White, and Samoan. It is missing for nearly all rows.

columns.name: applicant_race_observed
columns.description: A coded field associated with whether or how the applicant’s race was observed; it contains integer codes 1–3. The profile does not supply the meanings of those codes.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_observed
columns.description: A coded field associated with whether or how the co-applicant’s race was observed; it contains integer codes 1–4. The profile does not supply the meanings of those codes.

columns.name: applicant_sex
columns.description: The applicant’s coded sex response: 1 = Male, 2 = Female, 3 = information not provided, 4 = not applicable, and 6 = applicant selected both Male and Female.

columns.name: co_applicant_sex
columns.description: The co-applicant’s coded sex response: 1 = Male, 2 = Female, 3 = information not provided, 4 = not applicable, 5 = no co-applicant, and 6 = co-applicant selected both Male and Female.

columns.name: applicant_sex_observed
columns.description: Observed applicant sex, represented by integer category codes 1–3. The profile does not provide labels for the codes.

columns.name: co_applicant_sex_observed
columns.description: Observed co-applicant sex, represented by integer category codes 1–4. The profile does not provide labels for the codes.

columns.name: applicant_age
columns.description: Applicant age recorded in age bands (<25, 25–34, …, >74), with the special value 8888 also present. The profile does not specify what 8888 means.

columns.name: co_applicant_age
columns.description: Co-applicant age recorded in age bands (<25, 25–34, …, >74), with special values 8888 and 9999 also present. Their meanings are not specified by the profile.

columns.name: applicant_age_above_62
columns.description: Indicates whether the applicant is above age 62, using Yes/No values; some records are null.

columns.name: co_applicant_age_above_62
columns.description: Indicates whether the co-applicant is above age 62, using Yes/No values; most records are null.

columns.name: submission_of_application
columns.description: Coded category describing submission of the application, with observed codes 1, 2, 3, and 1111. The profile does not provide code labels or define 1111.

columns.name: initially_payable_to_institution
columns.description: Coded category for the institution to which the application is initially payable, with observed codes 1, 2, 3, and 1111. The profile does not provide code labels or define 1111.

columns.name: aus_1
columns.description: First coded AUS (automated underwriting system) value, with codes 1–6 and 1111 observed. The profile does not provide code labels or define 1111.

columns.name: aus_2
columns.description: Second, sparsely populated coded AUS value, with observed codes 1–4. The profile does not provide labels for these codes.

columns.name: aus_3
columns.description: Third, very sparsely populated coded AUS value, with observed codes 1 and 2. The profile does not provide labels for these codes.

columns.name: aus_4
columns.description: Fourth, very sparsely populated coded AUS value, with observed codes 1 and 2. The profile does not provide labels for these codes.

columns.name: aus_5
columns.description: Fifth, very sparsely populated coded AUS value, with observed codes 1 and 2. The profile does not provide labels for these codes.

columns.name: denial_reason_1
columns.description: First coded reason for denial, with codes 1–10 and 1111 observed. The profile does not provide code labels or define 1111.

columns.name: denial_reason_2
columns.description: Second, sparsely populated coded denial reason, with codes 1–9 observed. The profile does not provide labels for these codes.

columns.name: denial_reason_3
columns.description: Third, very sparsely populated coded denial reason, with codes 1–7 and 9 observed. The profile does not provide labels for these codes.

columns.name: denial_reason_4
columns.description: Fourth, extremely sparsely populated coded denial reason, with codes 1–9 observed. The profile does not provide labels for these codes.

columns.name: tract_population
columns.description: Population count for the census tract, recorded as an integer from 0 to 53,812.

columns.name: tract_minority_population_percent
columns.description: Percentage of the tract population identified as minority, recorded on a 0–100 percentage scale.

columns.name: ffiec_msa_md_median_family_income
columns.description: Median family income for the associated FFIEC MSA/MD, recorded as an integer amount from 0 to 134,800. The profile does not specify a currency or unit.

columns.name: tract_to_msa_income_percentage
columns.description: Tract income relative to the MSA/MD income, expressed as an integer percentage from 0 to 468; 100 represents the same numerical percentage level as the reference.

columns.name: tract_owner_occupied_units
columns.description: Count of owner-occupied housing units in the tract, recorded as an integer.

columns.name: tract_one_to_four_family_homes
columns.description: Count of one-to-four-family homes in the tract, recorded as an integer.

columns.name: tract_median_age_of_housing_units
